english.title: Fail ensure suffering protected animal subject to regulated procedures killed immediately in accordance with section 15A
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person who had subjected a protected animal, namely **(..SPECIFY ANIMAL..), to

(A)_[a series of]_
(B)_[the last of a series of]_

regulated procedures specified in section 2 of the Animals (Scientific Procedures) Act 1986 for a particular purpose, namely **(..SPECIFY PURPOSE..), when the animal was suffering or was likely to suffer adverse effects as a result, failed to ensure that the animal was immediately killed in accordance with section 15A of the said Act
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 15(1) and 22(3)(a) of the Animals (Scientific Procedures) Act 1986.
english.pointstoprove:

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Section 15(1) is without prejudice to any condition of a project licence requiring an animal to be killed at the conclusion of a regulated procedure in circumstances other than those mentioned in that subsection - section 15(2)
(ii) Imprisonment for this offence will be abolished when section 332 and Sch 37 Pt 9 of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 are brought into force.

other.penalty:
Three months imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Within three years after the commission of the offence and within six months after the date on which evidence sufficient in the opinion of the Director of Public Prosecutions to justify the proceedings comes to his knowledge.
